L18·N5416unmasked layer
This neuron fires on determiner/head positions of indefinite or newly-introduced noun phrases ("a", "an", "two", "of", capitalized new noun) and is strongly suppressed at definite-reference determiners ("the", "This", "These"), so it appears to track indefinite vs. definite NP marking.

L19·N5888unmasked layer
This neuron fires at the "slot" position just before an upcoming specific detail — most strongly on the bare space token preceding a number (date, hour count, percentage) and on the head word immediately preceding a specifying phrase (" logical" circuit, " mother" and step-father, " See" Description tab); very similar pre-number/pre-specifier positions can also drive it strongly negative, so it is a positional pre-specifier detector rather than a semantic one.

L31·N9527unmasked layer
Fires on tokens that are near-certain continuations of an already-determined word or number (the "000" of "100,000", the "ALLENG" of "CHALLENGE", "oub" of "untroubled"), and is strongly suppressed on arbitrary, unpredictable characters such as digits in patent numbers/timestamps or letters in random concatenated usernames — i.e. it tracks how predictable the current sub-word/digit token is.
